responsibility: Main GCC language-hook implementation for the Go frontend. It defines the Go-specific `lang_hooks`, creates the frontend IR state during initialization, sets default GCC options required by Go semantics (such as wraparound overflow behavior, exceptions, GC-root liveness, strict aliasing defaults, and default debug info), handles Go command-line options and file parsing, supplies type-for-size/mode hooks, custom gimplification for static chains, the Go exception personality, SARIF source-language naming, and utility services such as GC preservation and identifier localization; in short, this is the central file that plugs gccgo into GCC’s frontend framework.
